name: Last Halloween
source:
It's finally your favorite day of the year, Halloween! It's at a campfire party that you join your two friends Lily and Leo but not everything goes as planned... Will you have the courage to go through with it?

[From [url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/last-halloween]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
终于到了一年中你最喜欢的一天——万圣节！在一次篝火晚会上，你和两个朋友莉莉和利奥一起，但一切并没有按计划进行……你有勇气完成这一切吗？

[来自[url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/last-halloween]Itch.io[/url]]
